findings.detail: The team members have two names. The question calls them 'teammates', but option C and its reason call them 'each developer' and 'a developer'. One name should be used throughout.

blind_answer.reason: The conventions apply only to one directory, should load automatically, and must be shared via version control. A CLAUDE.md inside services/billing is a directory-level config: it is committed with the repo and applies only to that part of the codebase. The root CLAUDE.md would apply the conventions everywhere. User-level config is not shared with teammates. A slash command must be run manually, so it is not automatic.
